about_the_game:
"Heavenly Book" Demo Content

  • Playable from the start of the game until the “Leaving Shuiyue Residence” storyline (approximately 300 minutes of gameplay)

  • Experience the basic Alchemy System, Star Chart System, and Free Combat System

  • Play as the main character with initial Starstones

  • Includes partial Five Elements and Five Attributes combat mechanics

  • Demo save data will not carry over to the full version

  • Please avoid the coexistence of different language archives, as it may cause game errors.

Full Version Additional Content

  • Main storyline: Collect all 18 Heavenly Book fragments (including multiple side stories)

  • All playable characters and all Starstone abilities

  • Complete Five Elements and Five Attributes gameplay

  • Full Alchemy, Star Chart, and Team Combat systems

  • Full soundtrack

  • Additional equipment and special events

"Heavenly Book" — A Tale of Immortal Fate Awaits Your Writing

  • You are an ordinary office worker who accidentally travels to the mysterious world of the "Heavenly Book."

  • In this fantasy land steeped in the style of xianxia,

  • you will face countless challenges, explore uncharted realms, and discover your own destiny.

  • Every choice you make can alter the future, shaping you into a hero destined to rewrite fate.

    Game Features

  • Alchemy System: Master the art of harnessing herbs from heaven and earth to craft your own elixirs, helping you break through cultivation bottlenecks.

  • Star Chart System: Let the stars guide your destiny—every activation can change your path.

  • Free Combat System: Wield your sword and fight alongside your allies, with battles full of ever-changing variables.

  • Story Choice System: Between good and evil, follow your heart—each decision can alter your fate.

  • Starstone Embedding System: Collect and embed Starstones to enhance your abilities and gain the upper hand in the struggle between good and evil.

  • Five Elements and Five Attributes System: Harness the powers of mutual generation and restriction to strategically control the battlefield.

Explore the path of immortality and forge your own legend

  • In the world of "Heavenly Book," face endless trials, surpass your limits, and write your own chapter of destiny.

short_description: The Book of Heaven — Your Destiny, Your Path A regular office worker stumbles into The Book of Heaven. Explore vast lands, face trials, and uncover your destiny. Your choices shape your future — hero or villain, light or shadow. An epic journey awaits. The Book of Heaven is open — destiny awaits.
supported_languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
